about: [O7 after the critic, B2] the wanted man by medium hands: by his corner he turns ('Looking for me?') and fights (O4's crowd brawl); beaten once he gets up and runs; run down; E takes him in ('Come on.'); at the board the full reward. Through in one to three tries.

steps.label: medium hands: taken in within three tries

steps.eval: (() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('police'), d = s.door; const x = d.x + d.nx * 3.0, z = d.z + d.nz * 3.0; G.stage.part('stream').warmAround(x, z); N.controller.setPose(x, z, Math.atan2(d.nx, d.nz), 0); G.stage.part('bounds').navAround(x, z, 20); const M = G.night.bounty.men.get('b0'); if (M && M.c) { const q = { x: d.x + d.nx * 5.2, z: d.z + d.nz * 5.2 }; M.c.pos.x = q.x; M.c.pos.z = q.z; if (M.c.object) { M.c.object.position.x = q.x; M.c.object.position.z = q.z; } if (M.trail) M.trail.length = 0; } return 1; })()
steps.label: [O5b] (a tool's move of us both to headquarters' door - the walk across the city is not the contest; he no longer catches up by himself out of sight: after the critic he follows my way)

steps.walk: (() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('police'), F = s.frame; return [[0, 1.2], [0, -0.2], [0, -2.0], [0, -3.9]].map(([x, z]) => { const p = F.w(x, z); return [p.x, p.z]; }); })()
